Ingrid L.: Heads-up — eu-west GPU queue depth for mosaic-4b is ~3.1x baseline since 04:12 UTC. Latencies spiking, admission-control is rejecting ~18% of requests. Seeing KV cache growth and prefill backlog. :rotating_light:
Sam K.: grabbing metrics now, pushing graphs to #dash-ops. p50->p95 widened, but p99 is the scary one (3x). model qps steady though, looks like long tails.
ops-bot: [alert] eu-west queue depth > 5000 for model=mosaic-4b; pod_saturation=78%; fallback_routes_enabled=true
Maria P.: are these coming from a specific customer or many small ones? any change in per-customer rate?
Sam K.: mixed — several high-fanout customers + organic traffic spike from experiments. I can dump top-10 api keys in 30s.
Alex T.: we should prefer routing to mosaic-4b-quant for low-priority routes and throttle bursty api keys. Can we toggle per-key soft-limits?
Devon R.: cost note — routing to quantized will reduce GPU time ~2.2x but may regress output quality for some evals. need product sign-off for wholesale downgrade.
Ingrid L.: action plan: 1) immediate: enable per-key soft throttles for top noisy keys; 2) short-term: enable fallback routing to mosaic-4b-quant for tier=non-enterprise; 3) medium: increase admission-window by 10% and reduce max-prefill-size; 4) monitor for 30m and escalate if no drop. Anyone object?
Maria P.: +1 to soft throttles. Can we apply a 15rps cap with a token-bucket for the top 5 keys?
Alex T.: I can patch ratecontroller: set rate_limit_override for those keys. quick CLI:
```
POST /admin/keys/rate_override
{
  "key_id": "k_top1",
  "limit_rps": 15,
  "burst": 30,
  "expiry": "1715311550"
}
```
I'll run one after we confirm keys.
Sam K.: posted top keys in #dash-ops (redacted). Top1 is a bot test harness — we should throttle that aggressively.
Devon R.: product ok for non-enterprise routing to quantized as emergency mitigation, set flag for revert after 1h and trigger eval tests.
Ingrid L.: @ops-bot please run the following playbook steps and report back in this thread: 
- enable soft per-key throttles for top 5 keys
- flip fallback_routing for model group mosaic-4b -> mosaic-4b-quant for tier=non-enterprise
- decrease prefill window: cfg.prefill.max_tokens -> 1024
- set admission_window_multiplier -> 1.1
ops-bot: ack — executing step 1
ops-bot: enabled rate overrides for 5 keys (k_top1, k_top2, k_top3, k_top4, k_top5)
Sam K.: seeing queue depth drop at 04:21 UTC, now down 35%. p99 improving.
Alex T.: applied fallback routing rule, non-enterprise traffic now hitting quantized variant.
Devon R.: kicked off quick evals on quant route — small drop on safety/formatting edgecases but within thresholds for emergency.
Ingrid L.: good. keep monitoring. If metrics don't stabilize in 30m, we'll consider temporary shard increase (spin up 4 ephemeral pods) — note cost impact. Who can own the shard spin?
Alex T.: I can own the shard spin if we hit >20% rejection again. Will coordinate with infra to provision GPUs.
Maria P.: I'll keep customer comms ready for those top keys and flag the enterprise customers so we don't touch their traffic.
Ingrid L.: summary of owners: Alex=shard spin, Sam=metrics+dash, Maria=customer comms, Devon=evals/quality rollback, me=exec/decisions. Logging this as action items. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: closed: soft-throttles applied; fallback routing enabled; monitor window started.
